messages:
tom-sales: Quick prep: Capstone Bank RFP addendum requires POC showing EU+APAC residency and explicit no-US-control-plane. Also asking about audit log retention within-region and DSAR handling. Call in 20.
ravi-solutions: Key asks: 1) data stays in eu/ap for processing and logs, 2) control plane signalling never traverses US, 3) monthly reserved pricing for 6 weeks, 4) evidence for SOC2 & regional subproc, 5) how model caching (KV cache) behaves across regions.
marta-eng: Hosted endpoints exist eu-west-1/ap-northeast-1. For zero-control-plane-to-US we need Dedicated private-control-plane (VPC peering) or Private with local control-plane. Model KV cache is per-region; cross-region cache-sync is disabled if routing_fallback=disabled. That impacts cold-start latency.
eva-legal: They also want retention policy for logs within region and DSAR flow. We'll provide DPA addendum and a temporary POC attestation cert.
yuki-privacy: BYOK flow requested: HSM in customer region; wrapped key uploaded; unwrap only inside regional gateway; we can provide attestation but need customer to run HSM remote attest. Also DSAR: we need contact point and timeline (we usually respond within 30 days).
billing-bot: POC estimate generated: https://redwood.internal/quotes/1805552468 — shows dual-region dedicated per-hour + setup fee and month-to-month invoice.
ravi-solutions: Two options to present: (A) Dual-region Dedicated private-control-plane (compliant) — higher cost, per-hour reserved, setup. (B) Single-region Dedicated with geo-edge egress to AP when needed (cheaper) — may not satisfy strict residency. Include a line item for 'KV-cache pinning' to avoid cross-region caching.
marta-eng: Config snippet to include: `routing_policy: { primary_region: "eu-west-1", secondary_region: "ap-northeast-1", fallback: "disabled", kv_cache_pin: true }`
eva-legal: I'll attach subproc inventory + SOC2 links and a POC DPA template. Also note: any long-term residency guarantee requires negotiated addendum.
tom-sales: Action items: @marta-eng confirm impact on latency (estimate TTFB delta) with KV pinning; @yuki-privacy prepare BYOK attestation template; @eva-legal attach docs; @billing-bot confirm month-to-month cancellation terms. We'll surface both options on the call. Thanks :thumbsup: 
billing-bot: Attached: poc-dual-region-quote.xlsx, subproc-eu-ap.pdf
